text: Band is comfortable and the battery lasts 2 weeks but the app loses sync every other day. Have to re-pair constantly.
Sound is honestly insane for the price. Bass is punchy without getting muddy and the ANC kills the bus noise on my commute. Very happy with this one.
Way louder than it has any right to be at this size. Took it to the beach, sounded great.
Battery easily lasts 6 days with always-on display off. Sleep tracking is surprisingly accurate. Love it.
Charges my phone 4 times. Heavy but it's 20000mAh, what did you expect. Fast charging works with my Pixel.
Coming from AirPods Pro, these sound better imo but the case feels cheap and plasticky. The lid wobbles a bit. Keeping them anyway.
App crashes when I open sleep data. The band itself seems fine but without the app it's a watch that shows steps.
Good sound, decent bass for a small speaker. My JBL Flip is still a bit fuller but this is half the price.
Looks premium, strap is comfortable. Heart rate is a bit off during HIIT compared to my chest strap but fine for daily use.
Does the job. Charges my laptop over USB-C slowly but it works. A bit heavy for daily carry.
For the price this is great. Tracks steps, sleep and heart rate. Mi Band has more features but this one is more comfortable.
left bud keeps falling out when i run. tried all 3 tip sizes. great sound i guess but whats the point if its lying on the road
Party mode pairing with a second speaker is a nightmare. Took 30 mins and an app reinstall. Sound is nice once it works.
Switched from a Galaxy Watch. Battery here is way better, fewer apps. A trade off I'm ok with.
Took it on a 3 day trek, kept 2 phones and a headlamp alive. Solid.
Bought these for my daughter, she hasn't taken them off since. Says the call quality is way better than her old ones.
Sync failed again. Lost 3 days of workout data. Pretty frustrating for a fitness tracker whose whole job is tracking.
Bought two, I use them as a stereo pair in my room. Amazing for the money.
Notifications are delayed sometimes. Otherwise a nice watch, and the battery is great.
The LED indicator is useless, 4 dots that jump from full to 2 dots randomly. Capacity seems fine.
Decent. Nothing special. Sound is fine, battery is fine, fit is fine. It's a pair of earbuds.
Ordered on 20 Jan, arrived 3 Feb. Tracking showed 'out for delivery' for 5 days straight. Product is okay.
Light, comfortable, I forget I'm wearing it. Battery is excellent. App is slow but works.
Waterproof claim is real, it fell in the pool and survived. Sound is clear, bass is average.
Best watch I've owned. 5+ days battery, GPS locks fast on my runs, and the screen is bright even in direct sun.
Never received it. Courier says delivered, it was not. Please refund me.
Right earbud stopped charging after 3 weeks. Contacted support twice, no reply. I want a refund, not another 'we are looking into it' email.
App won't connect at all after my phone updated. Support asked me to reinstall 4 times. Please process my refund.
Distorts at full volume. If you keep it under 70% it's fine but then why advertise it as 'party loud'.
Good value. The app is a bit basic but the watch itself is solid. Charges from 0 to full in about an hour.
Delivery took 12 days and the box was already opened. Power bank works but I am not happy with the experience.
Pretty good noise cancelling, not quite my old Sony WF-1000XM4 level but at half the price I am not complaining. The EQ in the app is useful.
Good value. The strap gave me a rash after a week of wearing it 24/7. Switched to a cloth strap, now fine.
Gifted to my wife for Valentine's day, she plays her music in the kitchen all day. Battery lasts forever.
Got this for my dad, he uses it to track his walks. Simple enough for him to use on his own. Thank you Volta.
Late delivery but the power bank is good. Fast charge for my iPhone works with the right cable.
Gym, office, flights. Used them everywhere for a month. Battery easily lasts a full workday. 10/10 would buy again.
Good speaker. App is unnecessary, I never open it. Buttons on the speaker do everything.
Simple and does what I need. Step goals and water reminders keep me on track.
Better than my Anker which died after a year. Build feels tough and the rubbery finish doesn't slip.
Solid smartwatch. Battery lasts almost a week. Only complaint is the strap pin is fiddly.
Sound bahut accha hai, bass full on. Bas case thoda bulky hai, pocket mein fit nahi hota. Overall paisa vasool.
Sound quality bahut mast hai. Chhota hai par awaaz full. Recommended.
The band is great, the app is garbage. Can't export data, graphs are confusing and sync is hit or miss.
gets pretty hot when charging two things at once. not dangerous hot but noticeably warm
Accurate step count, great battery, and it doesn't look like a toy. Recommended it to my whole team.
Oh great, another 'premium' earbud where the touch controls pause my music every time I adjust my hat. Love that for me.
Battery life is ridiculous, 15 days on one charge. Display is readable outdoors.
Overpriced. Rs 4,999 for a speaker that sounds about as good as the Rs 2,500 ones. Brand tax.
Value for money. Cheaper than the similar Mi and Anker ones and it charges just as fast.
It's fine. The watch faces are ugly though, please add more options. Battery is the best part.
Comfortable enough for 3-4 hour sessions, which is rare for me. Mic is a bit muffled on calls though, people say I sound far away.
App ka sync issue abhi bhi hai. Band accha hai, par app mein data aadha hi aata hai.
Used it on a camping trip, battery lasted the whole weekend. The strap is handy.
Bhai full value for money. Phone 4-5 baar charge ho jata hai. Travel ke liye best.
Delivered next day, impressive. Setup took 5 mins. So far so good.
Better than my AirPods in every way except the app, which is clunky. Sound and ANC are top class.
App update finally fixed the syncing for me. Now it's a great band for the money.
Sound is good but there's a half second delay when I watch videos from my laptop. Annoying for movies.
Comfortable for sleep tracking, unlike my old Fitbit which was too bulky. Accurate enough.
Recharges itself in about 5 hours with a 20W charger. Not bad. Wish it had passthrough charging.
Arrived two days late and the box was crushed. Earbuds themselves work fine and sound good. Packaging needs work.
Honestly the best purchase I made this year. Crisp vocals, solid bass, tiny size.
Updated to firmware 4.2 yesterday and now the battery is dead by evening?? It used to last 5 days. What did you guys do.
Cheap, light, long battery. My mom loves it. Bought a second one for my dad.
After the latest update the battery drains 30% overnight with nothing running. This is unusable. I want a refund.
Clear highs, tight bass. Spatial mode is a gimmick but whatever. Wish the ear tips were softer.
Expensive for what it is. Same capacity is available for 30% less from other brands.
Pretty happy. It's not a Bose but it's not priced like one either.
wow amazing update, now my 'week long battery' watch needs charging twice a day. really innovative stuff volta
Heart rate jumps around during workouts. Fine for steps and sleep, not for serious training.
Connection drops every few minutes with my laptop. Phone is ok. Returning these, already raised the return request.
Small thing but I love the lanyard loop. Works well, no complaints.
Charging port broke after 6 weeks. Not covered because of 'physical damage'. I barely touched it. Want my money back.
Battery drain after update 4.2 is real. Watch gets warm on the wrist too. Support told me to factory reset, did that, no change. Returning it.
Stopped holding charge after 2 months. Goes from 100 to 0 in a day without use. Asking for a replacement.
I'm not an audiophile but these made me go back and relisten to old albums. That's the review.
App is much better than before. Syncs quickly now. Band is comfy.
Clear sound for podcasts and calls. The mic works surprisingly well as a speakerphone.
Update ke baad battery ek din bhi nahi chal rahi. Pehle 5 din chalti thi. Please jaldi fix karo.
Got it in 2 days, packed nicely. Setup was easy. Liking it so far.
Good buds. Fit is secure once you find the right tips. Would recommend to friends who don't want to spend AirPods money.
Played it at a small house party, people asked what brand it was. Good enough for me.
Still no fix for the battery drain. My old Fitbit never had this problem. Thinking of going back.
Used it during a 14 hour power cut. Kept the WiFi router and both phones running. Lifesaver.
The watch is good when it works but with the current firmware the battery barely makes it to lunch. Display and sensors are still great.
Fine speaker but the app keeps asking me to log in. Why does a speaker need an account.
ANC is decent but there's a constant hiss when nothing is playing. Can't unhear it now. Support said it's 'normal'.
Strap clasp broke after a month. For a band you wear every day the build should be better.
It's ok. Big and heavy. If you need capacity it's good, if you want something pocketable look elsewhere.
Requested a refund. Three weeks of 'our engineers are aware'. The battery dies in 10 hours now.
Great tracker, great price. Would recommend to anyone starting their fitness journey.
Good sound, nice colours. The price dropped a week after I bought it, which stings a little.
Third pair I've bought (gifts). Everyone loves them. Sound for the money is unbeatable.
Fast charging, decent build, reasonable price. Exactly what it says on the box.
Battery has been bad since the update, turning off raise-to-wake helps a little. Hoping for a patch. Everything else is great.
It's fine. Screen is small and hard to read during runs. Battery and comfort are great.
Ears hurt after an hour. Sound is great though. Mixed feelings.
Bass is weak, everything sounds a bit thin. My old Sony speaker sounded richer. Returning it.
The cable it came with stopped working in a week. Power bank is fine but come on, include a decent cable.
Survived a monsoon trek in my backpack side pocket. Still sounds great.
The June firmware update fixed the laptop connection issue I had. Now pretty much perfect. Bumping to 4 stars.
Firmware 4.2.1 fixed the battery drain for me. Back to 4-5 days. Phew. Took too long though.
Swimming mode works well, counted my laps correctly most of the time.
Charges my Switch and phone at the same time. Recommended for long flights.
Exactly what I wanted. Loud, small, lasts all day.
Bought it after the battery fix came out. Getting 5 days easily. Nice screen, comfortable strap.
Gym-proof. Sweat, rain, dropped one in a puddle. Still works. Sound is crisp.
Does everything my friend's Mi Band does for less money. App is decent now.
Second one I bought. The first one is 2 years old and still going strong.
Speaker is good, delivery packaging was terrible, just a polybag. Lucky it wasn't damaged.
Great watch, love the new watch faces. Battery is back to normal after the update.
For Rs 7,999 I expected better build quality. One of the buds rattles when I shake it. Want a replacement or my money back.
Stopped turning on after 6 weeks. No physical damage. I'd like a refund please, not store credit.
Works. Not sure it's really 20000mAh, I get maybe 3 full charges on a 4500mAh phone. Mehh.
Really solid little speaker. I'd pay a bit less for it but no regrets.
Battery is better after 4.2.1 but still not as good as before the April update. Maybe 3 days now.
Switched from a JBL pair, these are clearer in the mids. Battery a bit shorter than claimed but fine.
Arrived quickly this time and well packed. Good product.
Third month of using it daily, zero complaints. Battery, comfort, app all good now.
